India-England T20 Series Opener Washed Out by Rain

The first T20 match between India and England in Durham was abandoned due to rain. Despite the weather disruption, some Indian players like Shreyas and Abhishek scored fifties in the limited play. The series is a five-match T20 contest, with the next match scheduled for Manchester.
